P02.note: Y has a relative clause instead of a complement clause. Both are fine.

P03.note: X is grammatical, but 'their own' with a singular coach as the antecedent reads a little awkwardly.

P04.note: 'could convince nobody' is grammatical but less usual than 'couldn't convince anybody'.

P05.note: X fronts the wh-clause. That is grammatical and a bit literary, and would normally take a comma.

P07.note: X is less expected in meaning but perfectly grammatical and natural.

P08.note: X uses formal 'so...that' inversion. It is grammatical and literary.

P09.note: In Y the fronted 'without oxygen' would normally take a comma. Without one it is grammatical but slightly marked.

P10.note: In Y 'got to' means 'had the chance to'. Both are idiomatic.
